# Rossetta Sornabala

> Independent Management Consultant based in Toronto, Canada. I've built AI infrastructure at hyperscale. Now I help people make AI work.

For thirty years, at Microsoft, Hewlett Packard Enterprise and BlackBerry, my work has been making big technology change actually work for the people who live with it. Today I help leadership teams adopt AI across their organizations and deploy AI infrastructure in hyperscale data centers. My personal passion is mentoring founders who are using AI to win.

## Services

### AI Transformation
I help you turn AI into real productivity gains your people can feel, not another pilot that quietly stalls.
- High-value, time-saving use cases
- Measuring productivity gains and return on AI
- Automation and AI agents for routine work
- Change that brings people along

### Data Center Operations
I help you deploy AI infrastructure in hyperscale data centers with predictable, scalable delivery.
- GPU and AI cluster deployment programs
- Operational readiness and handoff
- Data center consolidation and migration
- Cross-functional delivery orchestration

### Startup Mentoring
I give founders honest counsel and the operating backbone to scale, and I help them use AI to win.
- Operating model and execution cadence
- Developing your team into leaders
- Go-to-market and partnership strategy
- Investor readiness

## Track record

- 2025 – 2026, Microsoft: Architected the Data Center Operations AI Transformation Program. I led AI transformation for 6,000+ technicians, engineers and managers across Americas data centers, from automation to AI agents.
- 2023 – 2025, Microsoft: Built the Americas Data Center Operations GPU Deployment Program. I built the program and operating model behind the Americas GPU deployment of some of the world's largest AI supercomputers: 5,000+ GPU clusters for frontier AI workloads.
- 2013 – 2018, Hewlett Packard Enterprise & DXC: Led the consolidation and migration of 52 data centers globally. I led global portfolio management for a $200M+ transformation program that delivered more than $250M in annual savings.
- 2010 – 2013, BlackBerry: Chief of Staff to the CIO. I was the bridge between the CIO's 18 VPs and BlackBerry's Enterprise Business Unit, working alongside the offices of the CEO, CFO, COO and CMO.

## Founders I've had the privilege to support

- NexLev (https://nexlev.io): an AI-powered YouTube platform that scans millions of channels to find high-demand, low-competition niches. Today the company has grown to 7 figures.
- Viralspot.ai (https://viralspot.ai): an AI-powered tool that helps creators spot viral content, craft hooks that convert, and skip endless research.
